title: On 2-distance-transitive circulant digraphs
summary: Circulant digraphs form a prominent class of Cayley digraphs defined on finite cyclic groups. Building on the existing classification of $2$-arc-transitive circulant graphs, this paper presents a complete classification of $2$-distance-transitive circulant digraphs.
